title: Tavily's published docs state the free plan provides 1,000 credits per month
statement: Tavily's own documentation at docs.tavily.com states that the free plan provides 1,000 API credits per month.
notes: ⚠️ Deliberately narrow, and split from the measured figure rather than merged with it (the #102 lesson). This claim is about WHAT THE DOCUMENTATION SAYS and a documentation fetch can settle it. It is NOT a claim about what any particular account receives — AST-0013 records that this account's live probe reported a plan limit of 1500 — and the two are not in conflict until something shows they are about the same quantity. A single assertion holding both would be unfalsifiable by either observation.
